questions: Should the output be exactly M lines, one for each k from 0 to M-1 in order, or is k given as an additional input parameter?
Is the inversion number computed for B after applying the modulo operation, or is it computed on the integer values of B (which are in [0, M-1])?
If M=1, all B_i are 0, so inversion number is always 0; should we still output M=1 line?
Are the lines printed in order of increasing k (0,1,...,M-1), or in some other order?
Should the inversion number be printed as an integer per line, without any extra spaces or characters?
Is the sequence B defined for each k independently, meaning we compute inversion number for each k from scratch?
If N is large (up to 2e5) and M is large (up to 2e5), is an O(NM) solution acceptable, or is efficiency a concern?
When computing remainders, should we use the non-negative remainder (0 <= r < M) as defined, or could a different modulo convention affect results?
